title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28): Financial Reporting enhancements
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 1 introduces enhancements to Financial Reporting that streamline report creation, distribution, and administration. Report authors can customize layouts and branding, users can automate report scheduling and run reports across dimensions, and administrators gain centralized control of defaults and audit logging.
key_points: Report authors can customize PDF outputs with company logos, override global defaults for negative number formats and logo placement
Report users can schedule reports for distribution groups and run reports across all dimension values
Administrators can set global defaults and monitor report usage through new audit logs
Financial Reporting replaces the legacy Account Schedules feature with new dedicated APIs and standard financial report templates
